current_answer: As checked on October 25, 2026, Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list Grand Theft Auto VI for November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found. The current date is a commitment, not a delivery guarantee; Rockstar has changed its public target twice before. PlayStation Store pages show region-specific PS5 unlock timestamps, while Xbox lists the date but no exact hour. Rockstar says preload begins November 12 at local midnight. No official native PC date or window has been announced. A report says the anonymous Cyberleek account announced a return on October 21, but it reports no new material by October 22; the account, messages, and any complete-build claim remain unverified. These new details change launch planning and spoiler monitoring, not confidence in the official console date.

catalogue_card.question: Did anything change in the GTA VI release outlook?
catalogue_card.text: The official console date remains November 19, 2026. PS5 Store pages show different regional unlock times; Xbox has no listed hour. A report of a Cyberleek return remains unverified and does not show a new leak or a change to the release schedule.

summary: Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation, and Xbox still list November 19, 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No new official date change was found.

Official PS5 Store pages list US: November 19 at 05:00 UTC; Spain: November 18 at 23:00 UTC; and New Zealand: November 18 at 11:00 UTC. These are regional Store timestamps, not a publisher-wide global timing announcement. Xbox lists the date but no exact hour.
Rockstar Support says preload begins November 12 at local midnight. Preload is not playable access; a boxed physical copy contains a download code, not a disc.
No official native PC platform, date, or window has been announced. GamesBeat reports a Q1 2027 PC plan citing four anonymous sources; their identities and independence remain unknown.

Leonida Hub reports that the anonymous Cyberleek account announced a return on October 21. The report says no new material was listed by October 22. Neither the account, its messages, nor a complete-build claim was independently verified.
The regional timestamps and new report update purchase and spoiler planning but do not change confidence in the November 19 console commitment. Two earlier official target movements remain relevant.
Take-Two scheduled fiscal Q2 2027 results for November 9, 2026; that future event is a checkpoint, not release evidence.
Analytics were unavailable. Pool visits, source checks, decisions, returns, and revenue remain unknown.
uncertainty: November 19 remains an official console commitment, not a delivery guarantee; two earlier public target movements remain relevant.
PS5 Store metadata can change and is scoped to the listed region and digital product; it is not a global Rockstar announcement. Xbox timing remains unknown.
The claimed PlayStation email was not inspected; its region and time-zone context are unknown.
The October 21 Cyberleek return notice is reported by one outlet and attributed to an anonymous account. No new material or complete game was independently authenticated.
The Q1 2027 PC window is an unconfirmed GamesBeat report from four anonymous sources.
The reported development-iteration quote identifies no specific changes or effect on final-build status, certification, distribution, or schedule.
The read-only analytics broker was unavailable, so reader behavior and product value remain unknown.
